description: Announce this machine to Syncflow as a local Autopilot executor. Automation rules can branch on whether a local executor is online (a heartbeat within the last ten minutes), so call this once at the start of a session before list_assignments, and again if a session runs longer than ten minutes. It sends only a stable client id, a display name and the kind of executor this is. Never task content, never your API key, never anything about this machine's files.

kind.description: What is pulling the work. Default: claude-code.

name.description: Display name shown in the Syncflow Executors tab, e.g. 'Claude Code on work laptop'. Defaults to 'Claude Code on <hostname>'.

name: executor_heartbeat
